title: VTU Circular: Revised Examination Timetable for B.E. 2025 Scheme First Semester
content: Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi. Revised notification regarding the conduct of first semester B.E./B.Tech examinations under the 2025 Engineering Scheme. Practical examinations will commence on 10th September 2026 and theory examinations will begin from 20th September 2026. All affiliated colleges must submit student internal assessment marks by 5th September 2026.
